title: Efficient Optimization with Encoded Ising Models
problem: Ising solvers (quantum, oscillator-based, and probabilistic computers) must include penalty terms to enforce constraints for combinatorial optimization problems, causing solvers to spend the majority of compute time exploring infeasible states and often failing to find any feasible solution.
motivation: Penalty-based constraint enforcement in standard Ising models wastes most of the solver's exploration budget on invalid states, severely limiting the practical utility of emerging quantum and probabilistic computing substrates for constrained optimization.
method: The Encoded Ising Model (E-I model) inserts a digital encoding circuit between the solver and the optimization landscape, using combinational logic (circuits that instantly compute outputs from inputs) to map the solver's spin states (output configurations) to legal variable assignments and prevent exploration of infeasible states. Instead of using energy penalties to discourage bad solutions, constraints are enforced as hard logical rules. The Fuse software framework lets researchers describe constrained optimization problems in high-level code and automatically deploy them to p-computer hardware, reducing wasted iterations by orders of magnitude.
key_novelty: A digital encoding circuit inserted into the Ising solver loop structurally prevents exploration of infeasible states by enforcing constraints as hard logical rules instead of energy penalties.
contributions: Encoded Ising Model (E-I model) formulation that uses digital encoding to eliminate infeasible states
Fuse software framework that allows high-level constraint specification and automatic lowering to p-computers
7.2x to 52000x reduction in iterations to find a feasible solution
Up to 100% estimated success probability improvement over penalty-based Ising formulations

metrics.speedup: 7.2x to 52000x reduction in iterations to solution
metrics.accuracy: Up to 100% higher estimated success probability over baseline Ising formulations

baselines: standard penalty-based Ising model formulations on p-computers
limitations: Evaluation is limited to a p-computer substrate; generalizability to quantum or oscillator-based solvers is claimed but not experimentally demonstrated.
primary_theme: encoded constraint enforcement for Ising-based combinatorial optimization
